title: Saudi Arabian Sweet Pudding
description: A traditional Saudi dessert, made with airy sweet pudding, perfect for hot days.

ingredients.name: arabian saudi pudding powder
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern grocery stores

instructions: Combine airy pudding and sweet arabian milk in a bowl.
Whisk until well combined and smooth.
Add arabian saudi pudding powder and whisk until thickened.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
Serve cold and garnish with additional powdered pudding if desired.
